name: Marine, character model sheet v2
prompt:
Pixel art character model sheet, landscape 1536x1024.
Style: 16-bit console-era pixel art (SNES / Mega Drive look). Chunky visible pixels on a clean grid: one art pixel = a 4x4 block of image pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no painterly shading. Limited palette, flat cel shading in 2 or 3 tones per material, 1-art-pixel dark outline (#14213d). Satirical caricature, bold readable silhouettes, slightly exaggerated proportions (big heads, small bodies). Palette anchors: ink #14213d, red #e3342f, azure #2563eb, gold #f2b630, cream #fffaf0, sea blues. Character: the woman in the attached reference photos, as a satirical 16-bit caricature: clearly enlarged head (about one third of the body height), blonde shoulder-length hair with volume and outward-curling ends, side parting, light green eyes, strong jaw, slightly drooping eyelids. Late fifties. The likeness must come from the face shape, the hair and the eyes, not from a realistic rendering.
Outfit and props: navy suit jacket and trousers, white shirt, black kitesurf harness with a red accent, black sandals, white board with red and blue edges, blue control bar held in both hands, 4 thin white kite lines leaving the bar towards the top right corner, cut 120 px above the bar (the kite is drawn separately). Outline the navy suit with a lighter navy rim light so it separates from any background.
Top row, full body standing, about 420 px tall, feet on the same invisible baseline: front view, three-quarter view facing right, side view facing right, back view. Neutral poker face.
Bottom row, six head-and-shoulders close-ups, about 200 px tall, all facing three-quarter right: 1) neutral poker face, half-lidded; 2) sly sideways glance, eyes to the right, lips closed; 3) small smug crooked half-smile; 4) scheming look, narrowed eyes, faint smirk, one eyebrow raised; 5) mild annoyance, lips pressed; 6) mid-sentence, mouth slightly open, one eyebrow raised, as if answering a question she dislikes. No broad smile, no shouting, no rage.
Flat solid chroma background #FF00FF, perfectly uniform, no gradient, no ground, no sea, no sky, no shadow, no reflection. At least 60 px of empty background between figures. No text, numbers, logos or borders. Never use magenta or pink inside any figure.

name: World style board: journalists, bystander, coin, theme boat
prompt:
Pixel art style board for the non-player elements of a kitesurf game, landscape 1536x1024, same pixel size, outline and palette as the attached approved character sheet (use it only for the style, do not draw her).
Style: 16-bit console-era pixel art (SNES / Mega Drive look). Chunky visible pixels on a clean grid: one art pixel = a 4x4 block of image pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no painterly shading. Limited palette, flat cel shading in 2 or 3 tones per material, 1-art-pixel dark outline (#14213d). Satirical caricature, bold readable silhouettes, slightly exaggerated proportions (big heads, small bodies). Palette anchors: ink #14213d, red #e3342f, azure #2563eb, gold #f2b630, cream #fffaf0, sea blues. Six objects in 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells, one object per cell, centred, side view facing left (they move from right to left), same scale logic as a rider about 300 px tall:
1. A small journalists' motorboat: white hull with a red stripe, a red triangular pennant on a mast, a cameraman in a red shirt holding a big TV camera, a second journalist holding a microphone on a boom.
2. A journalist hang-glider: a red delta wing, a journalist hanging under it in a red shirt with a camera round the neck, wide round astonished eyes and open mouth.
3. A gold coin, front view, thick, with an embossed star, 3 tones of gold, about 96 px wide.
4. A theme boat: a small flat barge carrying a miniature floating nuclear cooling tower with a puff of steam, a gold stripe on the dark hull.
5. A bystander standing on a short surfboard, simple neutral cartoon person, blue T-shirt, arms up in surprise, azure board.
6. A white cloud-shaped speech bubble with a pointed tail, empty (no text), thick ink outline.
Flat solid chroma background #FF00FF, perfectly uniform, no gradient, no ground, no sea, no sky, no shadow, no reflection. At least 60 px of empty background between figures. No text, numbers, logos or borders. Never use magenta or pink inside any figure.
